author: evdev
releaseNotes:
2026-08-13: 1.3.5 - Local device key fetch uses async Engine.IO polling with raw text bodies, persists session in atomicState, and parses adapter_update even when Hubitat JSON-decodes the socket payload.
2026-08-13: 1.3.4 - Fix local device key fetch: match pykumo Socket.IO subscribe/poll sequence, save Comfort Cloud user id, and fall back to the legacy v2 login when the socket push is empty.
2026-08-13: 1.3.3 - Fetch local device keys uses the same login as the setup page, re-signs in when the runtime token is stale, and no longer gets stuck after Done.
2026-08-13: 1.3.2 - Clarify local device key setup: automatic fetch with live progress, IP fields labeled as addresses only, per-zone IP vs key status.
2026-08-13: 1.3.1 - Local IP scan UX: pre-fill hub subnet, populate zone IP fields on match, per-unit status, and a live Find unit IPs progress page.
2026-08-13: 1.3.0 - Hybrid partial-offline polling (local where ready, cloud fallback elsewhere), credential-change auth reset, installer mode locks, improved operating state and °F lookup, wireless sensor index scan, and local adapter busy retry.
2026-08-13: 1.2.3 - Pass nested component state as JSON via data values and applyThermostatState; republish cached state on app init; improve debug logging visibility.
2026-08-13: 1.2.2 - Route nested component updates through applyThermostatState with queued publish and child parse() handlers.
2026-08-13: 1.2.1 - Fix nested component updates by sending events directly to child devices and improving component lookup.
2026-08-13: 1.2.0 - Nest indoor, filter, diagnostics, and wireless sensors under each zone thermostat. Upgrading recreates those satellite devices (thermostat IDs are unchanged).
2026-08-13: 1.1.2 - Indoor humidity from zone/MHK2/cloud, shared cloudStatus, live filterDirty on the Filter child, and defrost/standby on the thermostat.
2026-08-13: 1.1.1 - Hubitat button actions for local credential/IP refresh, improved command retry on auth/local failures, and Kumo local auth token fixes for Hubitat runtime.
2026-07-27: 1.1.0 - Hybrid local LAN control (pykumo protocol), offline local-only mode, per-zone IP settings, connectionPath attribute.
2026-07-26: 1.0.1 - Profile-driven fan modes and setpoint limits.
2026-07-26: 1.0.0 - Initial release.
